description: A real Title (large 22pt font, correctly detected) followed by a bold subheading set at body size (10pt). The Title heuristic works fine here; the subheading needs the bold-font-name signal (block_is_bold) to be promoted to SectionHeader instead of falling through to RegionClass::Text like the body paragraph beneath it.
